nodes.label: AshaSathi iOS App Icon (83.5x83.5@2x)
nodes.description: AshaSathi branded app icon for iPad Pro (167px). Bold green wordmark 'ASHA SATHI' with a house/home icon integrated above the letter 'S'. Color palette: medium green (#3DAA5C), very light mint/off-white background. Rounded square format. Clear, readable branding identity.

nodes.label: AshaSathi Brand Identity
nodes.description: Abstract concept node representing the AshaSathi visual brand identity as expressed across iOS assets: green color scheme signifying health/trust/home, house motif representing shelter/housing/home care, bold wordmark 'ASHA SATHI' (Asha = hope in Hindi/Sanskrit, Sathi = companion/friend), targeting home health and companion app use case.
